entries.zh: 肃静；安静无声，肃穆不喧
entries.en: quiet, still; solemnly silent
entries.notes: M 栏 jiēng 标[疑]；H 下原注〔paz〕示其义近「平安、宁静」。

entries.en: at ease, relaxed; free from care or trouble

entries.zh: 安静而体面（原稿以「料」对译，义不相合）
entries.en: quiet and honoured (Chinese 料 does not bear this sense; uncertain)
entries.notes: H「料」本义为物料、料想，与 L「quieto, honrrado」不合，疑为音近借字或原稿讹误，M 亦标[疑]。

entries.zh: 安定；安宁平静，引申为安分守礼
entries.en: peaceful, settled; quiet and well-ordered
entries.notes: M 另附「va」一式，来源未明，故降为中等。

entries.en: still, hushed; quiet as in meditation
entries.notes: H「禅」本指禅定，L 取其寂静一义，属宽式对译。

entries.en: peaceful and calm; moderate, even-tempered
entries.notes: L 栏自带[疑]标记，moderado 一义与 H「康」为宽式对应。

entries.en: still, silent; solitary and quiet
entries.notes: M 栏 T99 污损难辨（cheř），仅 H 与 L 互证。

entries.en: calm, peaceful, and honourable (Spanish tail is corrupt and unintelligible)
entries.notes: L 后半「y elg nomukennado」及 M 栏 [残]ju xo 均不可解，且 T99 污损。

entries.zh: 平允；公平允当，平和公正
entries.en: fair and impartial; even-handed and calm
entries.notes: H 义偏「公平」，与 L「quieto」仅宽式对应，M「in」标[疑]。

entries.en: safe and sound; free from trouble
great peace; tranquil times
entries.notes: M 栏窜入西语「y pacifico」，系原稿或转录混入，不影响 H 与 L 判读。

entries.en: steady, secure; calm and settled
entries.notes: M 附「va ūn」一式并标[疑:va/ũa]，第二式来源存疑。

entries.zh: 安乐无事；安宁和乐，不生事端
entries.en: peaceful and untroubled; at ease with nothing amiss
healthy and peaceful; well-being
prosperous and peaceful; well and at ease

entries.zh: 安分守己；谨守本分不越轨
entries.en: to keep to one's place and duty; mind one's own business
entries.notes: H 为动宾短语，L 以形容词对译，属宽式对应。

entries.en: in good health; hale and sound
entries.notes: H 实指身体康健，与 L「quieto y pacifico」义有偏移。

entries.en: relaxed and cheerful; free of constraint
entries.notes: M 栏 [残] 与 T99 并存，「šū piāng」「chū hiāng」两式难定。

entries.zh: 舒怀；宽解心怀，释然无忧
entries.en: to ease one's mind; carefree and unburdened
easy and comfortable; free from toil
entries.notes: M 栏首字 [残] 且 T99 污损（[残]ān it），形音难复。

entries.en: quiet, still; hushed

entries.zh: 和平；温和安宁，不起争执
entries.en: peaceful, mild; harmonious
entries.notes: M 后半「ℓChy」不可辨并标[疑]，仅前式 hō pēng 可读。
